attacks.title: A TAB/CR-leading region survives parsing and is exported raw (structural finding)
attacks.target: real tool_run of region values '\tTAB' and '\rCR'; sealed summary.csv bytes
expected: the run succeeds (TAB/CR are not formula characters and lstrip finds no formula)
the exported CSV does NOT escape/quote the TAB/CR prefix
the export writer's own defence-in-depth covers = + - @ but not TAB/CR: a real finding

finding.detail: prefixes only a first byte in = + - @; a leading TAB/CR is emitted raw and the csv writer does not quote CR when lineterminator='\n', so the exported row splits in a naive parser. A leading TAB/CR plus a formula character is unreachable because the parser's lstrip check rejects it first.
finding.severity: low (no formula execution; structural CSV ambiguity for CR-leading text)
finding.reported_not_fixed: T110 does not change product security semantics
